name: Journey: Screen Time Control
description:
Almost every app on your phone is engineered to keep you scrolling. Journey is engineered to get you off it by turning real-world habits into a game you actually want to play.
Each morning, you unlock a set of real-world quests like going to the gym, reading, running, or getting outside. Complete them and earn Knight's gold. The apps that waste your time stay locked until you buy more screentime, so you stop instinctively scrolling everytime you pick up your phone.

It's the same reward loop that makes games addictive, except now it's working for you instead of against you.

- Daily Habits
Every morning at 6 AM, your main quest resets. Each one is a real-world habit: exercise, reading, going outside. Earn time on social media by completing it or else you'll stay locked out. 
- App Blocking
Pick the apps that drain your focus and lock them down. Your apps unlock only after you buy more screentime with the gold you earn. 
- Focus Buddy
Your mascot reflects how you're doing. Stay off your phone and it thrives. Pick it up too much and it lets you know. It's a visual reminder that keeps you motivated to do better. 

*Access to Journey requires a paid subscription*
